mission.title: Behind the Curtain
mission.description: Track down Veil and plant a tracer on her.

npc.say: That item is a powerful tracer. It will pinpoint the location of Veil's hovercraft. Agent Gray will explain its use to you while you travel to the target location.

phase.briefing:
{player}, your skills are urgently required. Compliance is mandatory.
The operative known as Veil has been sighted in the Matrix. She is currently jacked in. Proceed to the location indicated for a more in-depth briefing before pursuing her further.

enter.say: Look for Agent West -- he's going to fill you in on the situation.

objective.text: Get the tracer from Agent West

talk.say:
You are present, {player}. I find this adequate.
Veil was sighted ten minutes ago, quite close to this building. From communications we intercepted, it appears that she is attending some sort of meeting. We do not know the nature of this meeting.
I have an item for you. Take it from me.

done.say: I wonder what the tracer does? In the meantime, you'd better head out of there.
That item is a powerful tracer. It will pinpoint the location of Veil's hovercraft. Agent Gray will explain its use to you while you travel to the target location.

phase.briefing:
That is a very powerful tracer program, {player}. Once placed, it will trace the location of Veil's hovercraft. We will shut down their systems and dispatch Sentinels to take custody of the crew.
Veil is in the next location. In addition to planting the device, you must discover the identity of the individual she is meeting.

enter.say: I'm reading signals all over the place, {player}... be careful in there!

done.say:
What the-- I had signals all over the place in there just a second ago! I-- hold on...
I've got exit signals, but no jackouts... and some sort of locational disturbance. This makes no sense.
Well get out of there, and I'll send you where the exit signals go. We'll get to the bottom of this!

phase.briefing: The exit signals from the previous site lead to the location indicated. Proceed there. Plant the device on Veil. Discover who she is meeting with.

enter.say: I'm reading some sort of flux... get in there fast!
Dead Zion ops all over the place... damn it! You'd better check those bodies.

done.say: Looks like some sort of encoded recording... you'd better upload that and I'll see what I can do with it. I don't think there's anything else in here.

objective.text: Upload the encoded recording at a hardline

complete.say:
Okay, I'm receiving that recording. Decoding... done. I wonder what--
Huh? Gray's link to us just went dead. What's up with that?
Anyhow, I downloaded that recording to your inventory. Keep an eye on your cellphone. I can't imagine that this business is over yet.
